title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: which Deductible is taken off a CargoCare settlement
content:
## Scope

This rule of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line selects the single Deductible taken off when a claim is settled under the CargoCare cover measure.

## Rule

1. One Deductible is taken off: the higher of the general Deductible per claim and the Deductible for the kind of loss.
2. The Deductible for the kind of loss is the wet damage Deductible for wet damage, the temperature damage Deductible for temperature damage, and none for any other kind of loss.
3. The general Deductible and the kind-of-loss Deductible are never both taken.

## Truth table (hypothetical Deductible figures)

Hypothetical figures: general 300.00 USD, wet damage 600.00 USD, temperature damage 450.00 USD.

| Kind of loss | Kind-of-loss Deductible | Deductible taken |
|---|---|---|
| Wet damage | 600.00 | 600.00 (the higher) |
| Temperature damage | 450.00 | 450.00 (the higher) |
| Physical damage | none | 300.00 |
| Shortage, contamination or total loss | none | 300.00 |

With a hypothetical temperature damage figure of 200.00 USD instead, a temperature damage claim takes 300.00 USD, the general figure being the higher.

## Wrong reading and correct basis

- *Wrong reading:* a wet damage claim takes 300.00 and 600.00, making 900.00. *Correct basis:* only the higher, 600.00, is taken; never both.
